content.description: Magna is a fast, compliant token distribution platform that supports airdrops, streams, unlocks and payments, designed to scale with your project. For users, it offers custom vesting schedules and a branded claim portal, aligned with the project’s branding, so stakeholders can support the project and claim their unlocked tokens. Developers can deploy Magna’s smart contracts and integrate via APIs. The platform also includes multi-signature workflows, dashboards for employees and investors, and tax withholding and compliance tooling.
